edges: South Dakota law governs the scope of employment inquiry based on a foreseeability test.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The case of Deuchar discusses the relationship of the employee’s conduct to the employer’s business in the context of scope of employment.
South Dakota has adopted the Restatement (Second) of Agency, which includes principles relevant to employment conduct.
